rows.label: all 15 presets: same state for the same t in any order; finite for t in [-3 .. 1e4]
maskRise: word i starts at i x 4 f, 14 f long, y 0.6 em -> 0, mask line
scaleSlam: 1.35 -> 1.00 in 6 f, motion blur only in the first 2 f, shake <= 8 px decaying, next word one beat (15 f) later
typewriter: 2 f per char, +6 f pause after punctuation, caret blinks every 15 f
elasticPop overshoot 27.5% at zeta 0.38 (research ~24%), 4.6% at zeta 0.7 (house cap ~7%)
scramble: glyphs swap (seeded), resolve left to right at 1.2 f per char, then the real letters
weightMorph reaches wght 800 at 18 f

outlineFill: outline only (fill 0, stroke 0.022 em) by 7 f and still at 14 f, fills over f 15-27, settles solid (fill 1, stroke 0) at 30 f; word i starts i x 5 f; line unit works; DOM + canvas know fill/stroke
outlineFill honours the reading-time lint: the default hold passes; an out before the last word has filled + 9 f is flagged
exits are 30% faster than entrances (dur x 0.7) and finish with opacity 0
holdTime = max(0.5 s, 0.35 + 0.28 s/word, 9 f): 1 word 0.63, 2 words 0.91
lintType flags a < 9 f hold and > 3.5 words/s; passes the default; lintPiece flags 3 tone families
